notes.title: V1.10
notes.content:
You can choose the default language and control mode when you first start the game.
Modified data for some parts.
Reduces maximum airframe speed and increases maneuver speed.
Add AI.
Added a scene.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/772848907339318805/9BA8BB5B19B9398EDB893CA38066509AFADBFF46/

notes.title: V1.8
notes.content:
Upgrade the previous twin engine to four engines
So other changes have been made, including parts, painting, scenes, HUD, particle effects, sound effects, settings, etc.
Added network features and name settings as well as shot down statistics.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/771720997271802937/C3D7E5115A838EB52B87E8CE85E2780A35987A03/
